name: MDN To-do Notifications

runtime.notes: The application appears to be static. The prototype can serve it internally without changing the original project.

understanding.synopsis: A to-do list application that stores tasks using IndexedDB and provides notifications when deadlines are reached via the Notifications and Vibration APIs.
capabilities: Provides notifications when to-do item deadlines are up
Uses the Vibration API for tactile feedback
Allows users to add new to-do items with custom deadlines
